instructions: Sets up a read-only crew of eight X helper bots on your own Grok Bot: follow tracking, follow suggestions, shoutouts, unanswered replies, fans, reruns and analytics. You set a daily X API spend cap, and none of the bots ever posts, follows or DMs for you.
